title: Ball Lightning (Leizu LMB, ref PoE2 Ball Lightning)
palette: Endesga 32 (sprites alpha 0/255); masks white-on-transparent, 6 alpha levels
mechanics: Unchanged from v1: orb drifts 1.8 px/frame (54 px/s) to the cursor, floats 9 px above its ground point, passes through enemies, every 6 f zaps up to 2 enemies within 44 px; fades at the cursor.
spawn: Spawn (first 7 x 40 ms): ball_lightning_spawn at the orb centre; spawn_flash from spawn frame 2. Then orb_loop (loop) + orb_heat (optional) at the orb centre.
orb_ground (loop) at the orb ground point (centre + 9 px down) for the whole flight; it replaces the v1 shadow.
orb_trail: one every 3 f at the orb centre, once.

Each zap tick: pick L in {16,24,32,40,48} nearest to the target distance, row = direction to the enemy chest; zap_Lxx_dir16 pivot at the orb centre; zap_hit + zap_hit_flash at the arc end (pivot + L along the row direction).
End: ball_lightning_fade at the orb centre, fade_flash from fade frame 2, fade_ground at the ground point.

base.sort: y-sorted with actors: key = ground y + offset given per strip
base.curve: frames as baked (no extra fade; fades are dissolves in the art)

glow.material: additive (One One), unlit, mask alpha x tint x gain, two passes: inner (small blur, near-white) + outer (wide blur, blue)
glow.sort: same sort key as its base strip + 1 (draws right after it)
glow.curve: frame-matched to the base; loops: x(0.85-1.15) per-frame flicker

ground.material: additive (One One) on the FLOOR sorting layer, below actors and decals-on-top
ground.sort: floor layer, above floor decals, below every actor
ground.curve: baked per frame; loops: x(0.8-1.2) flicker

flash.material: additive (One One), unlit, drawn on the top FX layer above actors; optional full-screen add = mean(mask) x screen gain
flash.sort: top FX layer (above actors and other FX)
flash.curve: baked per frame (impact frame first); screen flash 1 frame peak then 0

heat.material: screen-space distortion (grab pass / opaque texture): uv += (noise2D(uv*k + t) - 0.5) * mask * amp_px / screen_px; never drawn
heat.sort: after transparent FX, before the CRT post
heat.curve: baked per frame; scroll noise at ~6 Hz

decal.material: alpha-blend cutout on the FLOOR sorting layer (opaque dark pixels, dissolves by frame)
decal.sort: floor layer, below the ground light and actors
decal.curve: frames as baked, hold the last frame 0 ms (strip ends empty-ish)
